description:
A wizard with outstanding magical skills enough to become the Lord of the Northern Tower and a handsome appearance to match, had one worry that no one knew about... That was 'sympathy'! What's more, a rumor spread that he was a sympathizer because of his friend who was cheap. In order to put the rumor to rest, he summoned a dream horse and removed the tag! After many twists and turns, the summoned dream horse... But something was strange???!!!

 *"Wait a minute... Why am I lying on the bed instead of that dream horse?!?!?!"*

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: The fourth and last story in RIDI's Dopamine Danpyeonseon (도파민 단편선) Collection.*
